apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-contacts-service

  selector:

      app: ts-contacts-service

      labels:
        app: ts-contacts-service

      containers:

        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ts-contacts-mysql
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        ports:
        - containerPort: 12347
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 12347
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---

  selector:
